mode_columns: New wrk + old server or namespace missing

modes.New wrk + new enforced server: GET precreated canonical claim, verify task/host/lanes, then local claim/pane. Central role creates server claim first.
modes.Old wrk + new server: Local claim alone is unaccepted; server protected-task mutation denied; director refuses absent receipt
modes.New wrk + old server or namespace missin: Refuse with O3 unsupported, no pane/claim. Explicit legacy mode only for never-enrolled O2 jobs during rollout
modes.Offline/5xx for enforced jobs: Fail closed before new pane/work; unstarted central claim remains visible

modes.New wrk + new enforced server: POST round_open with expected_seq and exact head; receipt then local event, then reviewer starts
modes.Old wrk + new server: Local file cannot open a server round; director ignores it; legacy protected completion denied
modes.Offline/5xx for enforced jobs: Fail closed; do not start another tester; retain/retry same intent/key

modes.New wrk + new enforced server: Read bytes once; POST explicit round_no/head/bytes/digest; receipt then projection
modes.Old wrk + new server: Local verdict does not become trusted; server round remains pending
modes.New wrk + old server or namespace missin: Refuse; preserve reviewer file for later
modes.Offline/5xx for enforced jobs: Fail closed for acceptance; preserve bytes and pending intent, no accepted verdict

source.row_text: | round verdict | Read bytes once; POST explicit round_no/head/bytes/digest; receipt then projection | Local verdict does not become trusted; server round remains pending | Refuse; preserve reviewer file for later | Fail closed for acceptance; preserve bytes and pending intent, no accepted verdict |

modes.New wrk + new enforced server: POST void referencing exact server grant; receipt then local event
modes.Old wrk + new server: Local void never reduces server count

source.row_text: | round void | POST void referencing exact server grant; receipt then local event | Local void never reduces server count | Refuse | Fail closed; count stays charged |

modes.New wrk + new enforced server: GET summary/full paginated snapshot; additionally scan local unmatched evidence as warning
modes.Old wrk + new server: Local result is labelled O2/unverified by director; not accepted as canonical status
modes.New wrk + old server or namespace missin: May print local status only with explicit O2 unsupported warning
modes.Offline/5xx for enforced jobs: May print cached snapshot with stale=true, generation/seq/time and recorded warning; never report it current or use it for decisions

modes.New wrk + new enforced server: Upload bytes in journal POST, server gates and creates canonical receipt/relay atomically; local projection afterwards
modes.Old wrk + new server: Protected relay/task join denied without canonical receipt; local event cannot authorize join
modes.Offline/5xx for enforced jobs: Fail closed; no joined success or quota release

source.row_text: | joined | Upload bytes in journal POST, server gates and creates canonical receipt/relay atomically; local projection afterwards | Protected relay/task join denied without canonical receipt; local event cannot authorize join | Refuse | Fail closed; no joined success or quota release |

modes.New wrk + new enforced server: POST completed observation, warn if rounds incomplete, then local projection/housekeeping; completion is never join
modes.Old wrk + new server: Protected completed relay is denied without receipt; no quota release from local done
modes.New wrk + old server or namespace missin: Report may be saved locally with warning, command exits temporary-failure; no accepted completion
modes.Offline/5xx for enforced jobs: Preserve report and write pending warning; return temporary-failure (exit 75), no OK completion or quota release
